basis: The requirements are SRS-level contracts and do not require behavior implementation in this registration task.
Current source layout already has CLI read/mutation modules and MCP read/mutation registration modules that can host the planned surfaces.
The new requirements use evolving stability and planned status, so they are allowed candidates for future implementation planning.
Validation reports zero errors and zero warnings after index rollup updates.
